about: AI-written (Claude), 10 November 2026: adversarial verification of the agent ch07's changes in the AG review's eighth pass, on /Users/ren/tmp/ag/rv (branch ag-review, HEAD a2200f38e, uncommitted). I read ch07's report, its diff of 07, ten records, navigation.py and its pin; 07's thesis, Within the whole map, section 1's Read row, section 3's opening and 3.3 to 3.5, section 4's lead, table, C paragraph, theorem and not-shown list, 4.4, 4.5, 4.7, 4.8, 4.10, 4.11, section 5's lead, section 7, T4 and T8, does-not-show and Open; J1-FOR-AG.md and the seventh pass's critic and cold readings. I checked each changed sentence against the Lean statements it names: ConditionInTime.lean (not_unrestricted_inTime, unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime, unrestrictedAfter_iff_coupledEachStep, UnrestrictedAfter.eventually, RingOfThree.apart, Drawing.lapses, TwoSources.apart, «续无外当且仅当后与独», «独则同一中心», «后则无环»), GrammarScope.lean («续无外则同一中心», «各续无外则同一中心»), OwnClass.lean:411 («无环则返之所及唯己»), PremiseWitnesses.lean:314, 395, 412, 531, PersistingChoices.lean:853, Extension.lean:43, 57, 151, Direction.lean:90 and the J1/J2 theorems, FrontierFrames.lean:445, FromTheDynamics.lean:106, 123, BeyondCoupling.lean:329, 366. I edited no Lean, source, OPENING body, AGENTS.md, goal or generated page.

items.how: Verified in all four places and in the record (en and zh). T4's evidence already gives the lake result as the test's: 'IN1, frozen: ... no condition kept an untold dependent'.

items.item: H16 (a), J3's condition in time (thesis, section 3's opening, the table, 4.7, T8, 4.11's sentence)
items.how: Verified name by name in ConditionInTime.lean. 'Over what comes after' names only «续无外于后» (TwoSources) and is never joined with 'come to bear'. 'And only from the steps where they do' is gone. 4.11's sentence is J3's requested wording.

items.item: H16, 4.7 and T8 attached the in-time reading to the ranking (FIXED, medium)
items.how: ch07 had put the short form inside the ranking's antecedent: 'where relations close, read across all steps (read in time, only from some step on, ...), a self-concerned order already ranks every widening above, since every continuation lies within its reach'. Read that way, it says the ranking holds under the in-time reading. No theorem gives that. `datedOwnClosure` / `UnrestrictedEventually` appear only in ConditionInTime.lean, and no ranking theorem takes them. Under that reading an occurrence's own marking leaves out earlier steps, so by `exists_increasingInOwn_not_increasing` self-concern does not then rank every widening. It also said that relations, not the condition, close only from some step on. Both now read: '... so that their admissions end ([§4]); the ranking takes the condition read across all steps, and read in time the condition holds only from some step on, where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation ([§4.11])'. In T8 the next sentence's 'Where they run one way' became 'Where relations run one way', since 'they' had lost its referent. Neither sentence is quoted anywhere (grep).

items.item: H19 and H20 ('and' not 'so'; T8's order does not count)
items.how: The thesis has 'and ranking by widening adds no premise ... where the condition holds, that concern already does it'. The only 'so ranking by widening' left in 07 is 4.4's 'ranking by widening meets whatever C requires there', a different sense. T8 and 4.7 now say 'already ranks every widening above, since every continuation lies within its reach'. items.item: 07 §2: 'an order ranking eventual widening above meets more than C asks' (FIXED, medium)
items.how: Says more than is there: an order ranking eventual widening above need not meet C at all. A listed course eventually widens nothing (`Web.not_eventually_of_listed`), so ranking by eventual widening says nothing about the widenings C asks about on listings. The record itself says 'ranking it higher is a requirement beyond C' (eventual-widening does_not_show[1]). Now: 'Every law here is near-definitional, and ranking eventual widening above is a requirement beyond C'. That keeps H5 (C a requirement, nothing called better).

items.item: 07 'Within the whole map', the new AG reading (FIXED, medium)
items.how: ch07 took it from Fable's pass-7 finding 2: the first condition and 05's pooled couplings 'are ways of closing relations: they make a loss return to the selector, so that its own continuation reaches what it drains'. That joins two relations the Lean keeps apart. A pool or a reading rule couples a loss into what a selection reads (`Web.separates_all_iff_member`, `Flow.act_unselected_pool`). A center's own continuation and 'relations close' are read along being affected (`AffectedBy`: an exchange with a condition the center depends on, not one it gauges). 05's record says it does not show that a pool responds to what it separates. Now: 'can be read as ways of making a loss return to the selector: they couple the loss into what a selection reads, and where the selector is also affected, at some remove, by what it drains, relations close and its own continuation reaches what it drains'. The composition cites both halves ('`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`, with [§4.9]'). The limits now open with 'Coupling a loss in is not depending on it, and is not shown to make a selection respond to it ([05])'. Still labelled [AI reading, AG, 10 November 2026]. No quotes of it exist.

left.item: The first screen's anchor paragraph: its 'There' attaches the ranking to the in-time reading (medium; the screen agent's and the coordinator's)
left.why: The anchor reads: 'Read in time, it holds only from some step on, and there exactly where ... There, a course widens another when ... and whatever it adds lies within the life's own reach. Call a life's order ... self-concerned ...: there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens.' Coming straight after the in-time sentence, 'There' can be read as the in-time reading. No theorem ranks there. The ranking (`Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`, `increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`) takes `Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure rel) center)` on a relation between formations, read across all steps. Under the in-time reading an occurrence's reach leaves out earlier steps, so 'whatever it adds lies within the life's own reach' fails for a widening that adds an earlier item. Proposed: put the in-time sentence after the ranking ('... there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens. Read in time, the condition holds only from some step on, ...'), or begin the widening sentence 'Where relations close, read across all steps, a course widens ...'. Every front that follows the anchor carries the same order. 07 now says it as 'the ranking takes the condition read across all steps, and read in time the condition holds only from some step on, ...'.

for_ren: 07's 'Within the whole map' now carries an AI reading (labelled, 10 November 2026). The rule still reading what lies beyond the shapers' share, and 05's pooled couplings, can be read as ways of making a loss return to the selector. They couple the loss into what a selection reads, and where the selector is also affected, at some remove, by what it drains, relations close and its own continuation reaches what it drains. Where relations close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order already ranks every widening above. Where they cannot, counting the loss of those whose loss never returns is the step we offer. Its limits are in the same paragraph: coupling a loss in is not depending on it, and is not shown to make a selection respond to it; reach does not say which differences reach which selection, when and how strongly; and a rule that does not name a one-way dependent can still spare it. It joins the map for alignment to the ethics. It is a reading, not a theorem; the verifier separated the two relations the first draft had joined.

In 07 (4.7, T8) the ranking now says which reading of the condition it takes: 'the ranking takes the condition read across all steps, and read in time the condition holds only from some step on, where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation'. No theorem ranks under the in-time reading. The first screen's anchor paragraph places its 'There, ... that order already ranks every widening above' right after the in-time sentence; the coordinator should place it so the ranking follows 'read across all steps'.

07's direction (section 7) is said as its Lean takes it: the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, moves compared by widening. C is no longer listed among its hypotheses; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim (`Priority.comparison`).

C is defined with its parameter: on level paths, every claim counted, it asks that each course rank above every course it widens; in general it asks this for every course a course extends by a claim counted as living.
